title: The squat jump,
learned.
clips.lede: A person squat-jumping on a phone video became this simulated Unitree G1, controlled by a policy trained with reinforcement learning. It's the policy, not an animation of the video. Push it.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: a person squat-jumping, twice. SAM 3.1 segments them, SAM 3D Body lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab across thousands of simulated G1s, on 36 automatic variants of the clip, with pushes during training. What you see is that network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

title: The front kick,
learned.
clips.lede: Two front kicks on a phone video, turned into a policy that balances on one leg through each kick. Push it mid-kick.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: two front kicks with the right leg. SAM 3.1 segments the person, SAM 3D Body lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 automatic variants of the clip (mirrored, re-timed, rescaled), with pushes during training. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

title: The squat,
learned.
clips.lede: Two slow squats on a phone video. The policy follows the reference within a few degrees per joint, and keeps its feet planted when pushed.
clips.video: One clip from a phone: two bodyweight squats. SAM 3.1 segments the person, SAM 3D Body lifts their pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab tracking the retarget, trained on the clip itself (2,000 iterations), with pushes during training. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

facts.l: mean joint error to the reference

title: The lakeside run,
on the spot.
clips.lede: A runner filmed side-on in a tracking shot along a lakeside road. The G1 trains on the gait from this video. The clip travels; the G1 runs it in place.
clips.video: Pavel Danilyuk's clip (Pexels License). SAM 3.1 segments the person, SAM 3D Body lifts the pose to 3D, and the run's forward travel is taken out.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 automatic variants of the clip, warm-started from the squat-jump tracker, 1000 iterations. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

facts.l: of clean runs pass the clip's spec (3 of 13 key moments required)
of runs on held-out variants pass their own spec

credit.text: Pavel Danilyuk, "A Man Wearing Sunglasses Running in the Street", Pexels

title: The dance,
learned.
clips.lede: A dance on a phone video: the arms and hands carry the moves. Watch the robot build its environment and learn, attempt by attempt, then push the trained policy.
clips.video: A phone video of a dance, the project's own recording. SAM 3.1 segments the person, SAM 3D Body lifts the pose to 3D.
clips.policy: PPO in mjlab on 36 automatic variants of the clip, warm-started from the squat-jump tracker, 1500 iterations. The network's own run in MuJoCo, recorded.

facts.l: of clean runs pass the clip's spec (3 of 7 key moments required)
of runs on held-out variants pass their own spec

clips.caveat: Tracks the moves closely and stays up, but passes 3 of 9 key-moment stages: not a success by the spec yet
